Based on 8 relevant items from Wiki, Jira:

**Bug Triage Process** (Wiki): Bugs are triaged daily at 10am. Severity levels: P0 (site down, fix immediately), P1 (major feature broken, fix within 24h), P2 (minor feature, fix within sprint), P3 (cosmetic, backlog). Use the bug report template in Jira.

**Deployment Runbook** (Wiki): To deploy: 1) Run tests locally. 2) Create a PR to main. 3) After merge, CI runs automatically. 4) Monitor Grafana dashboards for 30 minutes. 5) If errors spike, rollback with ./rollback.sh.

**Refactor authentication middleware** (To Do, P2, assigned to Jennifer Park): Current auth middleware is 500 lines of nested callbacks. Refactor to async/await, add unit tests (target 80% coverage), and extract JWT validation into its own module. No behavior changes.

**Fix intermittent 502 errors on staging** (In Progress, P1, assigned to Sarah Chen): Staging environment returns 502 errors about once an hour. Logs show the Node process is being OOM-killed. Memory profile shows a leak in the websocket connection pool. Need to fix the cleanup logic.

**Company Onboarding Guide** (Wiki): Welcome to the company! This guide covers your first week: setting up your laptop, accessing email, joining Slack channels, and meeting your team. HR will schedule orientation on day one.
